denominatorNote: This live --pages 8 scan found 632 non-gated eligible representatives plus 22 gated/blocked representatives = 654 collected representative families. eligibleFamilies excludes gated entries; collectedRepresentativeFamilies is the inclusive scanned denominator. Both are refining lower bounds: counts vary with scan depth and with live Hugging Face catalogue churn even at the same depth. Always report the scan depth, retrieval time, and both counts; never imply complete/all coverage.

missionBaseline.note: Historical original-mission observation only; current same-depth scans can differ as the live sources change.

blockedRule: Gated representatives remain in collectedRepresentativeFamilies and are reported separately in blockedFamilies. The metadata scan cannot independently prove runtime execution or detect every device-only constraint; non-gated discoveries remain pending until verified, never built.

catalogue.reconciliationNote: Existing published entries were preserved byte-for-byte. Newly generated aliases colliding with an already published built/blocked slug or task+family (19), plus two -x aliases of existing pending identities, were rejected. No pending discovery was promoted to built.
catalogue.catalogueNote: models.json is cumulative across historical scans (including the prior 40-page scan), so its 2690 entries are not a subset of this 8-page snapshot. built/eligible and built/collected ratios are conventional headline arithmetic, not a measured set-overlap coverage percentage.

depthCurveNote: Historical observations from earlier scans, not fixed invariants or predictions; the current 8-page result differs because the upstream live catalogue changed.
